name: Vitreous-Machair

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs magnetic pole anomalies, stark under a black sky.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
For traders, silicon alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
